input.state: One source-valid current final hard state P.
input.force_single: One admissible R1 query u=c with u in U=X union Y and c in A(u), or
input.force_pair: One admissible R2 query u=v=c with uv a nonedge and c in A(u) intersect A(v).
input.base_state: First construct only the B2B0-sealed one-step forced base state.

purpose: Determine what happens immediately after one source-legitimate forced-color step. Do not recurse. Do not assume the forced base state already belongs to the full authoritative final class.

allowed: Recompute source list data from the enlarged seed.
Perform deterministic/source-canonical repartition steps whose correctness for this exact input class is already sealed or proved inside this gate.
Recompile already-sealed component/message objects when their declared inputs changed.
Stop at the first missing invariant or unsupported normalization dependency.
forbidden: Calling R1 or R2 recursively on a successor.
Using generic P7-free 4-precoloring or mixed List-4 solving.
Importing a P6-specific CSZ normalization lemma unless an existing P7-valid transfer theorem explicitly matches the new forced state.
Inventing a progress measure before the delta inventory is observed.
Branching on an unbounded set of new forced vertices.

ordered_invariant_audit.name: SOURCE_LIST_REPARTITION_V
checks: recompute exact palettes A with fixed X0
identify vertices whose source list size/class changed
determine whether axiom (v) is restored by an authorized deterministic repartition

ordered_invariant_audit.name: VI_STATUS
checks: whether a single 3-list color class controls every Y vertex adjacent to residual Y0 as required by the current source contract
whether the state is terminal because residual Y0 or the relevant Y-neighborhood disappears
if false, record exact distinct surviving list classes and witnesses

ordered_invariant_audit.name: C0_COMPONENT_COMPILATION
checks: component base-list systems after the force
whether every residual component remains in the sealed C0 domain

A_TERMINAL.definition: The forced state is decidable by an already sealed backend without another R1/R2 call.

B_HARD_RETURN_WITH_CERTIFIED_PROGRESS.definition: After the one-pass audit, the state satisfies the same authoritative hard-state contract.
required_certificate: strict progress measure value before and after
proof that normalization cannot increase/regenerate that measure along the authorized successor relation
polynomial bound on distinct successor states produced by one input state
B_HARD_RETURN_WITH_CERTIFIED_PROGRESS.firewall: Seed growth by itself or local list shrinkage by itself is not an admissible progress proof.

C_ESCAPE_FROM_AUTHORIZED_CLASS.definition: The first required invariant that is not established is recorded and execution stops.
required_certificate: whether the escape is a theorem failure, missing transfer theorem, or merely unavailable backend

killer_question: Does every source-valid forced-color query terminate after one authorized pass, or return to the same hard class with a rigorously monotone polynomially bounded successor structure; otherwise preserve the first source-valid ESCAPE witness.

success_criteria.inventory_pass: Every tested/source-generated forced step receives exactly one of the three terminals with a replayable receipt.
success_criteria.progress_theorem_pass: May be promoted only if HARD_RETURN cases have a proved non-regenerating strict measure and polynomial successor bound.
success_criteria.algorithmic_R1_R2_pass: NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_GATE even if finite examples all terminate.
